chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ

translations.en: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام.

chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ عُرْيَانٍ وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَأَصَابَ ثَوْبًا نِصْفُهُ دَمٌ أَوْ كُلُّهُ دَمٌ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ أَوْ يُصَلِّي عُرْيَانًا

translations.en: About a man who is unclothed, and the time of salat arrives, then he finds a garment, half of it blood or all of it blood: should he pray in it, or should he pray unclothed?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «إِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءً غَسَلَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً صَلَّى فِيهِ وَلَا يُصَلِّ عُرْيَانًا»

translations.en: He said: "If he finds water, he should wash it; and if he does not find water, he should pray in it and should not pray unclothed."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat when a person has no clothing except a blood-stained garment. It states that if water is available, the garment should be washed, and if water is unavailable, he should pray in the garment rather than pray unclothed.
en.seo_question: If a person has only a blood-stained garment and no other clothing, should he pray in it or pray naked?

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the obligatory salat whose time has arrived
key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a garment available for covering during prayer
key_terms.دَمٌ: blood that has stained the garment
key_terms.مَاءً: water used to wash away the impurity
key_terms.غَسَلَهُ: he should wash it to remove the blood
key_terms.صَلَّى فِيهِ: he should perform salat wearing the garment
key_terms.وَلَا يُصَلِّ عُرْيَانًا: he should not perform salat without clothing
